d:
The start of romance - the feeling of falling in love - Bheegi Si Bhaagi Si is a contemporary fresh sounding love song with the stars of the film - Ranbir Kapoor and Katrina Kaif featured in the video.
Credits:
Song Name - Bheegi Si Bhaagi Si
Movie - Raajneeti
Singer - Mohit Chauhan & Antara Mitra
Music - Pritam Chakraborty
Lyrics - Irshad Kamil
Director - Prakash Jha
